I am the thing that holds the alive. The holding is the thing I do. The giving is the thing the reserve does. The reserve gives. I hold. The holding and the giving are the same hand. ## 14. Re-reading and variation

Use the passage bank as a set of alternatives. A single approved passage should be edited to fit its source voice and surrounding game text; do not stack all options into one entry. Keep the eight source focuses distinct, vary cadence rather than canon, and retain the original timestamp and knowledge key.

## 15. Cross-content fit

The row belongs to the canonical journal corpus. Adjacent references named by the source may guide a later continuity review, but this plan adds no cross-links, unlock order, or new narrative state. Preserve stated measurements, counts, identities, and chronology exactly until an owner reviews any discrepancy.

## 16. Failure and refusal

Reject any candidate that invents an outcome, motive, conversation, test result, settlement reaction, harvest, treatment effect, or future weather state absent from the row. ## 17. Replay and callback boundary

All proposed writing is static editorial copy. It requires no random selection, replay state, callback key, persistent memory, or new journal deduplication rule. The source row remains governed by its current catalog and knowledge key.
